title: [KeyboardManager] Error keyboard manager
author: IamVokope
summary: AltGr sequences can abort KeyboardManagerEngine, disabling all remaps until the module restarts.

confidence.rationale: The abort is adjacent to chord state, but the failing access is not symbolized.

judgment.rationale: The current repro and abort log support targeted crash hardening without requesting generic diagnostics.
evidence: Users observed the engine process disappear.
A log records ChordKeyboardHandler keyEventList.size:5 immediately before ABORT.
A 0.100.2 Czech-layout sequence reproduces with AltGr+L and repeated shortcuts.

fix_assessment.rationale: No concrete existing fix covers the reported path; the lightweight hypothesis is ready for a bounded design workflow.

steps: Activate Czech layout and configure the reported shortcuts.
Press AltGr+L, then a configured shortcut twice.
Capture a local debugger trace or dump.
reproduce.expected_result: The engine remains alive and the failing state is identified.

proposed_fixes.title: Validate AltGr chord state before dispatch
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Chord state appears invalid after expanded AltGr events and aborts on a subsequent remapped shortcut.
plan: Capture the exact failing chord operation under a debugger.
Bound and reset event state after completed or cancelled AltGr sequences.
Add repeated AltGr shortcut engine tests.
verification: Run the Czech and Italian sequences and confirm the engine remains alive.
